notes: SqueekChain (src/SqueekChain.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named SqueekChain, symbol SQK, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 SQK (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the factory. There is no owner, no mint, no burn, no pause, no blocklist and no transfer fee, so every launch flow moves exactly what it says. The launch deploys no application contracts.
